Prices range from ₩3,500 noodle bars to ₩89,000 seafood hotpot sets, with side-alley spots on Wausan-ro 21-gil running 20–30% cheaper than the main tourist strip. results.title: Hongdae Dakgalbi, 4428 Convoy St, Ste 130, San Diego, CA 92111, US - MapQuest
results.content:
Hongdae Dakgalbi is a Korean restaurant located on Convoy Street in San Diego, specializing in dakgalbi, a spicy stir-fried chicken dish. The signature dish features diced chicken, cabbage, rice cakes, and gochujang sauce, often prepared at the table.

The menu also includes popular options such as cheese fondue, udon noodles, and fried rice made from the leftover sauce. The dining experience is casual and interactive, encouraging sharing among guests.
